messages:
Nadia M.: I pulled together a cutover + rollback playbook for the slice-based refactor. Want quick feedback before I file the PR.
Theo V.: skimmed. high level looks good. Couple of asks: explicit traffic-shift step sizes, and a clear invariant for when to run a forced rollback.
Omar R.: forced rollback triggers should be deterministic. propose: (1) sustained p95 > 700ms for 30m, (2) error_rate > 0.75% for 15m, (3) schema_mismatch>0.05% in 10m. Any of those -> immediate reroute to monolith shim.
Nadia M.: agreed. I'll encode those thresholds in the router policy. Also adding a fast-fail 412 for schema validation so we don't try to process incompatible payloads.
Theo V.: what about traffic shifting cadence? I prefer narrower increments: 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 60% over 96h with health checks between each. That gives time to react without destabilizing autoscaler.
Omar R.: add one extra step for high-tenancy customers: per-tenant opt-in canary. we should run a tenant sweep to identify heavy hitters and exclude them during early ramps.
Nadia M.: ops runbook excerpt I'll include in PR:
```
- pre-cutover
  - create snapshot for KV prefill
  - warm workers with synthetic load (10% of expected qps)
  - freeze infra autoscale-burst for 24h
- canary rollout (flagged)
  - step schedule: 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 60%
  - wait window: 45m per step, run smoke + replay tests
  - gating checks: p50, p95, 5xx_rate, schema_mismatch
- rollback
  - trigger: any guardrail tripped
  - action: flip routing to monolith shim, mark canary FAILED, start postmortem timer
- post-cutover
  - dual-write period: 14 days
  - remove old endpoints: 60 days after stable
```
Theo V.: testing: please include golden-replay of last 24h of production traffic (anonymized) against staging slice. Need to confirm cache warmup behavior and prefix cache hit rates.
Omar R.: telemetry: capture route_version + worker_id + fingerprint. store failing payloads in quarantined blobstore for 14d. Also add a metric `shim_fallback_rate` to track how often we hit the monolith shim.
platform-bot: CI alpha job `slice_cutover_smoke` created. Link: https://ci.internal/job/slice_cutover_smoke/987
Nadia M.: thanks. last item: ownership and paydown. I propose a ticket template that assigns debt owner and a hard cut date for code removal. We should not leave compatibility shims indefinitely.
Theo V.: +1 to debt owner. Also add a small scoreboard: weekly debt-paydown status in the architecture channel for first 90 days.
Omar R.: scheduling: aim for staging canary next Monday, prod canary three weeks later. I'll check storage IO budget with infra.
Nadia M.: great. I'll upload PR with playbook + router policy snippets tonight. Please comment if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
